_comment: Copy to archive-people.json (gitignored) and fill in real ids. `owner` is you (one entry, shared across everyone) and lets the archiver tell your messages from theirs. Each person maps a registry key -> per-service identity. Telegram: user_id + the ChatExport_* dir you exported from Telegram Desktop. Discord: user_id (their Discord user id, matched against DM recipients) and/or channel_ids (explicit channel ids), plus optionally package_dir (your extracted data package). SMS: numbers (matched by last-10-digits), plus optionally xml_file (the SMS Backup & Restore export).
